Triumph Announces updates for Off-Road Models

November 10 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:22
Instaread

The 2027 Triumph TF 450-X, TF 250-E and TF 450-E motorcycles have been updated with improvements to chassis design, powertrain, and rider control.

TF 450-X Highlights:

•             TF 450-X evolves for 2027 with race-developed updates ahead of its 2nd Monster Energy AMA SuperCross season and MXGP debut

•             Revised engine calibration enhances torque delivery, refines the maximum engine rpm limiter strategy, and improves throttle-to-rear-wheel connectivity

•             Updated cylinder head components enhance durability, reliability, and high-rpm stability

•             New clutch pack and comprehensive gearchange updates improve durability, engagement, and shift precision

•             Revised KYB suspension settings and new toolless adjusters enhance control and rider feedback

•             New 50-tooth final drive improves acceleration and drive out of corners

•             Premium race-ready componentry and advanced rider technology as standard

•             New all-black bodywork with Triumph Racing Yellow accents

Enduro – TF 250-E & TF 450-E Highlights:

•             Latest KYB suspension with revised settings and new tool-free adjustability

•             New precision-tuned Neken triple clamps for the TF 250-E further refine front-end performance

•             Powertrain updates improve shifting and control

•             Premium Brembo, Galfer, and ProTaper components with advanced rider technology fitted as standard

•             New all-black bodywork and new graphics

•             2026 international racing success includes 15 victories and 62 podium finishes
